pinned.sentence: **Profiles & extensions:** **29 of 55** gates met, plus **2 recorded negative results** (`TXT.4` repeated-structure prose ambiguity in Stage 1; `TXT.8` Unicode text marks erased by standard folding).

evidence.quote: | Later profiles, EXT and RC | 55 | 29 (TS.1, TS.2, TS.3, PY.1, PY.2, PY.3, IMGF.1, IMGF.2, IMGF.3, IMGF.4, IMG.0, IMG.1, IMG.2, IMG.3, IMG.4, IMG.5, TXT.1, TXT.2, TXT.3, TXT.7, RES.1, C2PA.3, SK.1, SK.2, SK.3, WEB.0, WEB.1, WEB.2, WEB.3) | 2 (TXT.4, TXT.8) | 24 (WEB.4–WEB.6 and SK.4–SK.5 planned; PY.4 open) |

**Verdict: `negative-result` confirmed for Unicode carriers.** Lane 09's reading that homoglyph and zero-width Unicode carriers are erased by the declared deterministic fold (`NFKC` + UTS #39 `skeleton` + delete `Default_Ignorable_Code_Point`) and that AWT post-hoc lexical rewriting is rightly rejected is independently confirmed. Any new text-mark experiment remains owner-blocked.

**Verdict: no blocking findings. Recommend lifting the previous TS.2 evidence hold for frozen stage-1 `ts-tokens` draft-2.** The missing selection classes and the stronger within-stage input-rejection pairing requirement now have evidence. This is a scoped recommendation, not a gate/status/count edit, implementation agreement result, or approval of deferred profiles.
The sole added met ID is **IMGF.1**.
Exactly the five authorized rows change from open to met.
**Verdict: eligible as SK.3 design evidence, with the precise boundaries and dispositions below.**
The sole new met gate is **SK.3**, as a design/review/citation gate.
The sole new met gate is **WEB.3**, on its unchanged literal fixed-fixture catalogue/body/replay criterion.

pinned.rationale: The integrated recount combines the scoped IMGF.1 closure with IMG.5, TS.1/TS.2 and TXT.1/TXT.2: 29 of 55 met, TXT.4/TXT.8 negative-result and 24 open. IMG.5 uses the reviewed draft-schema route; TS and TXT closures cover only frozen stage-1 ts-tokens and text-plain, with documented text result-rejection pairing. TSX/Markdown remain deferred. IMGF.1 adopts research arithmetic without normative promotion or universal equivalence. SK.3 adds reviewed local-first design evidence only; I1–I4 are unresolved and C1 remains a nonblocking clarification. It grants no SK.4 conformance, SK.5 hosting, owner defaults or namespace publication. WEB.3 adds only accepted bounded catalogue/body/replay fixture evidence at Shelf 99a1a8b; the independent final addendum closes the synthetic drop/download gap. Fingerprint9/9 core plus1/1 drop, Compare17/17 and Replay20 expected checks (13 reproduced/seven correct mismatches) plusnine invalid refusals remain distinct. WEB.4/5/6 and broader native chooser/AT/privacy/performance claims remain open.
